extensionDescription.message: Save the current YouTube video to a Litloft folder using its usual import workflow.

settingsIntro.message: Connect your Litloft server once, then save videos directly from YouTube.

sttHint.message: This choice is saved for the extension separately from the Litloft website. Automatic speech-to-text requires the intelligence addon.

saved.message: Saved. Open a YouTube video to add it to Litloft.

unlockHint.message: Unlock other drives in Litloft, then refresh the extension.

importSuccess.message: Added. Metadata, captions and other processing continue in Litloft.

importUnknown.message: The server response was not confirmed. Check the folder in Litloft before trying again: the video may already have been added.

importing.message: Adding… You can close this panel.

chooseAgain.message: Choose a folder and try again

unsupportedPage.message: Open a YouTube video or Short to add it to Litloft.

noDrives.message: No accessible drives. Open Litloft to unlock your drives, then refresh.

chooseFolder.message: Choose a folder to add immediately. Use + to browse subfolders.

chooseHint.message: Selecting a folder starts Litloft's usual video import.

invalidServer.message: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS address, including its port if needed. Use the server address without a path, login, query or fragment.

invalidDestination.message: This folder is no longer available. Refresh the folder list.

invalidSettings.message: Choose one of the available speech-to-text modes.

permissionRequired.message: Allow access to your Litloft server in extension settings.

notAllowed.message: This action is not available on this page.

configureServer.message: Open Settings to connect your Litloft server.

staleVideo.message: The video changed. Open the panel again for the current video.

settingsChanged.message: The server settings changed. Refresh before choosing a folder.

unavailable.message: This drive is unavailable. Open Litloft to check access, then refresh.

importUnavailable.message: URL import is unavailable on this drive. Check the media_import addon and its drive settings in Litloft.

requestFailed.message: Litloft could not complete this request. Check the server and try refreshing.

connectionError.message: Cannot reach Litloft. Check the address, connection and server permission. If drives stay locked, check Chrome's third-party cookie settings for Litloft.
